name: A1 a zero denominator becomes a rate of zero
old: if (!denominator) return absent(key, label, emptyReason, { unit: 'rate', basis });
new: if (!denominator) return measured(key, label, 0, { unit: 'rate', basis });

name: A2 snap share is offered as route participation
new: measured('route_participation', 'Snap share as route participation', snapShare ?? 0, { unit: 'pct' }),

name: A3 the unmeasurable stats are dropped from the block
old: absent('yards_per_route_run', 'Yards per route run', UNAVAILABLE.routes, { unit: 'yards' }),

name: A4 the routes reason becomes a claim about the player
aimed_at: T3 a fact about the platform
old:
routes: 'No routes-run data exists on this platform. Route counts are not in the '
    + 'weekly files this page is built from, and the sources that publish them are paid.',
new: routes: 'This player has no routes on file for the season being played.',

name: A5 a passer's rate uses targets like everyone else's
A6 the denominator stops being named
aimed_at: T5 basis named, T6 passer basis

name: A7 a player with no rows is explained by the wrong absence
aimed_at: T8 the right absence for no usage rows

name: A8 weeks_measured is invented rather than counted
A9 the panel renders only the stats that have numbers
aimed_at: T11 absences survive to the page

name: A10 a failed load renders as a player with nothing to show
aimed_at: T12 failed load is not an empty block

name: A11 the panel is unmounted from the player page
aimed_at: T10 mounted and asking the right endpoint

name: C1 control: a comment reworded, nothing behavioural
old: /** The mean of the non-null values, or null when nothing was measured. */
new: /** Mean of the values that are present; null when none are. */
